name: @silurus/ooxml-legacy-converter
description: Optional legacy Office converter WASM for @silurus/ooxml
author: Yuki Yokotani <silurus.dev@gmail.com>

scripts.wasm: cd parser && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../src/wasm && node ../../../scripts/append-wasm-reinit.mjs ../src/wasm/legacy_office_converter.js
scripts.wasm:direct-ppt: cd parser && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../src/wasm-direct-ppt --features direct-ppt && node ../../../scripts/append-wasm-reinit.mjs ../src/wasm-direct-ppt/legacy_office_converter.js
scripts.wasm:direct-xls: cd parser && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../src/wasm-direct-xls --features direct-xls && node ../../../scripts/append-wasm-reinit.mjs ../src/wasm-direct-xls/legacy_office_converter.js
